risks.title: DRC cobalt export restrictions impacting volumes and revenues
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the EBITDA bridge as a volume reduction factor (significantly reduced DRC cobalt sales, following the imposition of export restrictions). Direct and quantified language; recent trend with material 2025 impact on copper unit costs (denominator effect).

risks.title: Dependence on thermal and coking coal prices
risks.score_rationale: Coal EBITDA declined 30% in 2025 (steelmaking coal -22%, energy coal -23% on reference prices), representing an entire division of USD 3.7 billion. Recurring structural risk, amplified by global energy transition; confirmed downward trend.

risks.title: Operational risk and mining sequence on copper production
risks.score_rationale: Copper production down 11% in 2025 (852 kt vs 952 kt), mainly due to lower head grades at Collahuasi and Mount Isa closure. Risk cited in detail in operational scorecard; direct impact on revenues and unit costs.

risks.title: Regulatory complexity and land access for growth projects
risks.score_rationale: Document explicitly cites RIGI approvals (Argentina), land access for MARA and El Pachón, and MOUs with US government for KCC/MUMI. Multiple key projects depend on multi-jurisdictional government authorizations; conditional language (if all near-term projects progress to FID).

risks.title: Water management and environmental constraints on EVR
risks.score_rationale: Document mentions water management plan under implementation at EVR, with USD 1.3 billion average annual capex 2026-2028 including water treatment facilities (over 50M liters/day by 2027). Environmental operational risk with quantified capex impact.

risks.title: Geopolitical exposure in high-risk jurisdictions
risks.score_rationale: Glencore operates in Kazakhstan (Kazzinc), DRC (KCC, MUMI), South Africa (ferrochrome), Philippines and Colombia (Cerrejon). DRC cobalt restrictions and voluntary Cerrejon cutbacks illustrate materialization of this risk in 2025; high-weight category for a diversified miner.

risks.title: Reputation risk linked to coal activities and past litigation
risks.score_rationale: Document mentions a UK tax matter of USD -1.0 billion in shareholder return calculation, and Glencore has history of litigation (corruption, FCPA). Coal monetization strategy (Puerto Nuevo terminal sale, portfolio simplification) reflects growing ESG pressure.

risks.title: Competition and consolidation in commodity marketing
risks.score_rationale: Marketing Adj. EBIT declined 8% to USD 2.9 billion, with coal/steel segment down 32%. Long-term guidance (USD 2.3-3.5 billion) implies structural competitive pressure. Glencore explicitly cites well-supplied markets and physical dislocations as factors in variable performance.

ai_positioning.summary: Glencore makes no mention of significant artificial intelligence strategy or initiatives in its 2023 annual report. The company focuses on mining, trading and energy transition, without signaling AI adoption for operational or commercial optimization.
evidence: No mention of AI or machine learning in Business, MD&A or Innovation sections.
No reference to predictive analytics tools, automation or AI assistants.
Cited technology investments focus on decarbonization and energy efficiency, not digital or AI.
